notes.title: Take part in testing.
notes.content:
My dear friends.
I am happy to announce that I am starting to recruit participants for testing! If you want to be among the first to try out the gameplay and help make the game better, join our testing!
Write to us in [url=https://discord.gg/4xQVHfKvEw]Discord[/url].
Good and positive to all.


[url=https://discord.gg/4xQVHfKvEw]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Interaction between different weapons.
notes.content:
Added Interaction  between different weapons. 
For example: if you have a staff with poison in one hand, the second weapon will shoot poison bullets that slow down and do periodic small damage. 
I like it, but I can't add this mechanic to the demo :(

notes.title: Demo version released
notes.content:
Prepare to descend into the depths of darkness and face the relentless hordes of evil that await you.
   Navigate through procedurally generated levels, each filled with vicious enemies. With each playthrough, the layout of the levels changes.
   Choose from a varied arsenal of weapons, each with their own strengths and abilities, and fight your way through enemies to bosses.
